title: Big picture, round 2: one switcher, calmer detail

steps.path: Big picture: the switcher above all four views
steps.headline: Keep the switcher: four views over one set of facts, and it stays on what you were looking at.
steps.changed: One page with four buttons: Systems, Journeys, Foundations, How it works. Under them, one line says what the view on screen answers. All four read the same facts file.
steps.notice: Pick a thing in one view and switch: the next view opens on that same thing, named at the top right ("Looking at …"). ✕ lets it go.
steps.risk: Two views still name one thing differently (How it works says "Saved agent recipes"); its detail lists the other name.

steps.path: Big picture → Systems, as it opens
steps.headline: Systems, first view: keep the calmer version?
steps.changed: The first view keeps its boxes and squares, with a shorter intro line. Every square now names itself when you point at it.
steps.notice: Same picture; less to read. Unfamiliar words like Mesh explain themselves on hover.

steps.path: Big picture → Systems, after one click
steps.headline: Systems, after a click: keep the shorter detail?
steps.changed: Inside a system: plain feature tiles with names and status words, and a short "Connects to" list. The nine rows of tiny squares and the long connection list are gone.
steps.notice: You see what is in the system without decoding colour; at most five connections show, the rest behind More.
steps.risk: The two pictures are different clicks: round 1 opened a whole system, round 2 one feature inside Agents.

steps.path: Big picture → Journeys, as it opens
steps.headline: Journeys, first view: keep the calmer version?
steps.changed: Each journey row has one short line ("Stops at step 6: …") instead of three, and the side lists say "4 journeys" instead of rows of numbered black chips.
steps.notice: Rows read at a glance; point at a line to see why it stops, or at "4 journeys" to see which.

steps.path: Big picture → Journeys, after one click
steps.headline: Journeys, after a click: keep the shorter detail?
steps.changed: A clicked step shows its name, status, one sentence and three facts: what it waits on, what it holds up, where it belongs. The rest is behind More.
steps.notice: "Holds up 3 journeys" is clickable and lights those rows. A "with a catch" step now says what the catch is.

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, as it opens
steps.headline: Foundations, first view: keep the calmer version?
steps.changed: Finished things fold into one "N things that already work" strip per floor, so the unfinished ones show their full names. Badges are gone; "floating" is now "missing support"; Build next shows three things.
steps.notice: Far fewer boxes and almost no cut-off names. The bottom floor still needs a scroll; a "More below" button says so.

steps.path: Big picture → Foundations, after one click
steps.headline: Foundations, after a click: keep the shorter detail?
steps.changed: A clicked block shows name, status, one sentence and three facts. The panel fits the window, and the lines now run under the blocks, faint, never over text.
steps.notice: The tester's worst moment (a cut-off panel with lines across the text) is fixed.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works, as it opens
steps.headline: How it works, first view: keep the calmer version?
steps.changed: Same diagram, in the light colours the other views use, fitting the width. The "what is not finished" list is one short line each instead of paragraphs.
steps.notice: It looks like the other three views now, and the side list scans quickly. Hover gives the reasons.

steps.path: Big picture → How it works, after one click
steps.headline: How it works, after a click: keep the shorter detail?
steps.changed: A clicked part shows name, status, one sentence and three facts, with code locations behind More. "Follow a message" says which assistant you are following.
steps.notice: Each step of a trace is one short sentence. A part also lists the name the other views call it.
